observations: Black oscillating pedestal fan with a 3-blade design.
The brand name 'QASA' is visible on the center of the motor housing in photo 1.
The fan is mounted on a black pedestal base with a power cord.
The fan is shown stationary in both photos.
Watermarks for 'TOY STORE' are present on both images.

claims.evidence: The item is shown, but the 'rechargeable' feature is not demonstrated; it may be a standard plug-in model.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The fan may be a standard plug-in model rather than a rechargeable one.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment and a video of it being charged.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or the blades may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running through all speed settings.

risks.risk: The oscillation function may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan head moving side to side.

proof_requests: Video of the fan powered on and running through all speed settings.
Photo of the battery compartment to confirm if it is rechargeable.
Video showing the oscillation function working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
